cards.title: July jobs report shows a sharp hiring slowdown

cards.mechanism: A weaker labor market increases the case for front-loading rate cuts, including a half-point move.

cards.title: July CPI confirms further disinflation
claims: Headline CPI rose 0.2% in July and 2.9% over twelve months; core CPI rose 0.2%.

claims: Powell said the time had come for policy to adjust and emphasized downside employment risks.

cards.mechanism: Weak revisions support a larger cut, while the unemployment decline reduces the urgency for an emergency-sized move.

cards.mechanism: A firmer core reading weakens the case for a half-point cut at the immediately following meeting.
